transcript.content:
The issue is in `src/transformers/tokenization_utils_base.py`. The warning at line 2227 is raised unconditionally when `padding=True` and `max_length` is not None, but it fails to account for the case where `truncation=True` is also set. When truncation is active, `max_length` IS used for truncation, so the warning is incorrect/misleading.

The fix is to only show the warning when truncation is also not active (i.e., `truncation is False`). At the point of the check (line 2226), `truncation` is still the original user-provided value (could be `True`, `False`, or a strategy string), so we can check `truncation is False`.
